correctness.rationale: The orthogonal additive projector P=Σ_iE_i-(d-1)E gives K=Σ1_match/q_i-(d-1). The martingale coupling of Bernoulli(ri)/ri versus Bernoulli(qi)/qi has conditional mean preservation, with strict |.| Jensen precisely at a negative-to-positive crossing. Every subset of the other independent coordinates has positive mass, so the stepwise support-gap criterion is iff. Under R/T masking, a matched rare R coordinate forces positive K; without any rare R match, all T terms stay below d-1, giving exact norm 1+2(|R|-1)∏(1-ri), and nonminimum R choices have strict deficit. In the d=3k+2 biased family R=2k+2 rare coordinate masses 1/(2d) and T=k masses 1/3, so exactly 2^k corners. Independent exact rational test at d=5 gave two maximizers, common row norm 24683/5000.
residual_risks: The R/T conditions describe one sufficient complete flat-face regime, not every possible norming locus; finite rational enumeration supports but does not replace the all-d proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Centered first-chaos lacks the constant kernel term and is thus a different sharp-norm problem. The i.i.d. affine result classifies rare-corner versus at most d adjacent resonant corners for equal p, not independent heterogeneous rare masking with 2^k free coordinates.

originality.rationale: The complete norming-row criterion for heterogeneous finite-product additive L2 projections and the full rigid-times-free masking regime are not supplied by existing sharp-norm theorems. The earlier first-chaos product result omits the constant, and the earlier biased-affine Bernoulli result treats identical biases and only one-coordinate resonance; neither forces arbitrarily large 2^k norming sets with all coordinates biased. Weighted pseudo-Boolean least-squares formulas supply the projector but not this equality-locus classification.
residual_risks: Equivalent equality-case martingale/convex-order formula under a different product-ANOVA title may be unindexed. No claim of globally sharp classification outside the stated sufficient masked regime.

value.rationale: The complete equality-case locus of a natural additive ANOVA projector is a structural extremizer problem that sharp norm values alone do not settle. The exact support-kink test, full rigid-times-free face, quantitative norm gap and biased 2^k multiplicity family explain a nontrivial degeneracy in multivariate least-squares amplification and can guide equality/stability investigations.
residual_risks: Masking inequalities are sufficient for the simple face classification; general algorithmic test may be exponential.

limitations: The complete optimum row set is proved under exact finite full-support independent product assumptions. Weighted product pseudo-Boolean literature covers coefficient formulas but may hide unindexed equivalent equality conditions.
Finite checks are corroboration, not substitute for universal proof.
